title: Project Parithyaga: relief packages for students hit by the floods
excerpt: After a needs assessment, IEEE CS prepared personalised relief packages for University of Peradeniya students affected by flooding — supported by the IEEE Sri Lanka Section.
content:
Project Parithyaga was a humanitarian initiative supporting University of Peradeniya students affected by flooding.

Instead of distributing funds directly, the team first carried out a needs assessment, then purchased essential items and prepared personalised relief packages for each student.

The project was organised by the IEEE Computer Society Student Branch Chapter with support from the IEEE Sri Lanka Section.
